description: 応急給水施設一覧(2025年4月1日更新) [drinking water supply] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 豊田市. 大規模災害時などの被災時に応急給水活動を行う施設一覧を掲載します。. Coverage: 豊田市. The portal files it under the publisher 豊田市. Its tags are 位置情報, 災害, 給水. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-11-13 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
